name: Workers AI
summary: Workers AI runs models on serverless GPUs in Cloudflare's network, called from Workers through the AI binding or from the Cloudflare REST API. It is the default model provider in the Agents SDK starter, and the same binding also reaches other providers' models through AI Gateway.
facts: Generally available, Workers Free and Paid plans
$0.011 per 1,000 Neurons above the free allocation; per-model token rates listed
goodFor: Agents already running on Cloudflare Workers
watchOut: Anthropic and OpenAI models go through AI Gateway, not Workers AI
Some larger models need Workers Paid or prepaid credits
